purpose: Define the only permitted path from official IEBC Form 34B image scans to constituency turnout observations. Machine transcription is treated as a candidate reading, never as a verified source integer by itself.

registered_voters.verification: Must be visually/source-image verified from the official Form 34B and exactly reconcile to the governed P23 IEBC registered-voter observation for the same constituency.

total_valid_votes.verification: Must be visually/source-image verified from the official Form 34B. Where candidate-vote rows are independently readable, their exact sum must reconcile to this total.

rejected_ballots.verification: Must be visually/source-image verified from the official Form 34B.

preconditions: registered_voters equals the governed P23 constituency registered-voter value
turnout_derivation.rounding: Store the exact source integers; calculate turnout from integers and round only the display percentage.

promotion_policy.partial_rows: Remain unresolved and are retained in the extraction audit artifact. They do not create series or observations.
promotion_policy.all_or_nothing_phase_rule: P23 cannot close until all 290 existing turnout slot instances are either source-backed verified observations or an independently approved governed evidence closure. This extraction contract itself does not create such a closure.

prohibited_methods: promoting raw OCR or machine transcription without source-image verification
silently correcting OCR digits to make arithmetic or denominators reconcile
copying county, ward, media, citizen-tally or candidate-party values into missing Form 34B fields
using the verified form-id arithmetic relation to infer any result value
marking a partial or unreadable row verified
dropping an unresolved constituency from the 290-row extraction audit
acceptance: The extraction audit contains exactly 290 canonical constituency rows, including unresolved rows.
Every row points to its governed official IEBC Form 34B source reference and source-file digest.
Every promoted numeric field is individually source_verified with page-level evidence.
Every verified registered-voter value reconciles exactly to the governed P23 constituency voter denominator.
Every verified turnout value passes arithmetic and range rules.
No unresolved or mismatched row is silently repaired or omitted.
No observation is promoted unless the full row verification_state is verified.
The 20,115-slot governed completeness denominator remains unchanged.
